research_mode: official UK government and ONS primary statistical releases and methodology only; every claim carries a fail-closed limitation; no parcel result, exact incident location, candidate value, local risk score or business result claimed

sources.name: Annual and mid-year release scope
verified_claims: The March release contains the full range of workforce statistics, while the September release is shorter and focuses on workers in post.
limitations: March and September products do not contain identical breakdowns.

sources.name: Biannual workforce units
verified_claims: Biannual workforce numbers are available on FTE and headcount bases, except specials and volunteers are headcount only.
limitations: Unit labels must be retained in comparisons.

sources.name: Promotion coverage
verified_claims: Promotion statistics cover territorial forces and exclude British Transport Police.
limitations: BTP promotion counts must not be inferred from national promotion totals.

sources.name: Function-data coverage
verified_claims: Police-function statistics cover territorial forces and exclude British Transport Police.
limitations: Function analyses cannot be generalised to BTP.

sources.name: Long-term absence coverage
verified_claims: Long-term-absence statistics include territorial forces and British Transport Police.
limitations: Absence coverage differs from functions and promotions coverage.

sources.name: Additional protected-characteristics annex
verified_claims: The annex reports disability status, sexual orientation and religious belief for officers on a headcount basis.
limitations: Completion is lower for some protected characteristics and estimates require caution.

sources.name: Personnel-record source
verified_claims: Published workforce figures are sourced from police-force personnel records.
limitations: Administrative records reflect force HR processes rather than independent observation.

sources.name: HR and payroll alignment
verified_claims: Force HR and payroll systems are not always aligned and some differences require manual correction.
limitations: Delayed reconciliation can affect snapshot accuracy.

sources.name: Special and volunteer review cycle
verified_claims: Special-constable and volunteer counts can fluctuate depending on how often forces remove inactive records.
limitations: Force-level year-on-year changes require caution.

sources.name: Protected-characteristic source
verified_claims: Sex, ethnicity and age are recorded in HR systems and can be amended by workers or HR.
limitations: Missing or outdated self-reported fields can affect completeness.

sources.name: Ethnicity classification break
verified_claims: Ethnicity collection moved from aggregated categories to 18+1 and later 19+1 classifications.
limitations: Asian and Other group comparisons across the classification change are difficult.

sources.name: Lower-completion characteristics
verified_claims: Sexual orientation, disability and religious-belief data are lower quality because completion is lower.
limitations: Unknown values must not be allocated to a category.

sources.name: Protected-characteristic self-reporting
verified_claims: Protected characteristics are self-reported in force HR systems.
limitations: Non-response should remain explicit.

sources.name: Sex and gender comparability
verified_claims: Some forces historically did not distinguish sex from gender, and analysts sometimes used gender where sex was unavailable.
limitations: Sex and gender fields are not fully interchangeable.

sources.name: Joiner and leaver timing
verified_claims: Late HR updates can place a small number of joiners or leavers in the wrong financial period.
limitations: Period-end totals may be slightly inaccurate.

sources.name: Entry and exit classification
verified_claims: Joiner and leaver route data depend on forces interpreting Home Office definitions correctly.
limitations: Misclassification risk is greater at force level than nationally.

sources.name: Workforce accredited status
verified_claims: The workforce series is accredited official statistics under the Code of Practice.
limitations: Accreditation does not remove documented force-level limitations.

sources.name: Cross-country comparison caution
verified_claims: The guide warns that workforce datasets from different jurisdictions may not be directly comparable because collection differs.
limitations: International or UK-jurisdiction comparisons require harmonisation.

sources.name: Neighbourhood-function revision break
verified_claims: A validation exercise produced substantial revisions to March 2024 neighbourhood-function data.
limitations: Data before March 2024 are not directly comparable with data from March 2024 onward.

sources.name: Neighbourhood training coding
verified_claims: Officers and PCSOs in classroom training should not be coded to the active neighbourhood function, while a separate destined-for-neighbourhood category is collected.
limitations: Training and deployed neighbourhood personnel must remain separately identified.
